description: Computes SVG paths, endpoint positions, and arrowhead geometry for wireframe connectors. All methods are pure (no side effects) and can be unit-tested without a Blazor host.

members.name: BuildArrowMarkers
members.description: Generates SVG marker definitions for start and end arrowheads.

members.name: BuildPath
members.description: Builds an SVG path d attribute for the given connector.

members.name: GetArrowMarkerRef
members.description: Returns SVG marker-end / marker-start attribute value for a registered arrowhead. Callers should embed the referenced marker definitions in SVG <defs>.

members.name: GetLabelPosition
members.description: Returns a point approximately halfway along the path for label placement.
